notes.title: Nintendo Switch release & upcoming updates to Steam
notes.notes:
We've just released OTTTD on the [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/otttd-over-the-top-tower-defense-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url]. 

So now you can buy the game again and play on the go. 
Or just recommend it to a friend who missed out in 2014! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6274116/46261aba2dfa32857f7de4ec6732d31d51e5737c.png[/img]

We'll also be doing a small update here on Steam to match some of the features added for the Switch. Hoping to have this done this week.

FFWD: You can now speed up the action!!
EASY & MEDIUM DIFFICULTY: For those that just want to enjoy the ride

We're all heads down on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/996770/Moving_Out/]Moving Out[/url] and No Way Home right now but wanted to say thanks for the support. Anyone who bought OTTTD are true OG fans!

cheers
Ash@SMG

notes.title: Update 1.24 is here! Fixes, fixes and additions!
notes.notes:
Hello HEROCORP employees!

Thanks to everyone who has been playing since the launch on Steam - we've received a tonne of feedback, and we want you to know that here at HEROCORP, we value your contribution. It's been a tad busy around here, but we're getting into ship shape with out first official update! 

We've added an option for left or right click to move heroes, tweaked the hot key system, added some visual feedback, and fixed up those pesky achievements. If you still have some issues, please report them in the bug thread on the community hub.

We'll see you on the battlefield! 
Steve

[h1] 12/08/14

[list]
[*]Option for left click or right click to move heroes (right click is default)
[*]Function keys to select units - F1, F2, F3 to select heroes during a misison (tab key removed)
[*]Added cursor display for invalid movement locations
[*]Ground texture fix - Ground textures should no longer disappear when alt+tabbing in/out of the game
[*]All Stars achievement fixed - Was not triggering
[*]Only Rocket Towers achievement fixed - Was not triggering
[*]Million Coins achievement fixed - Was not persisting through plays
[*]9001 Enemies achievement fixed - Was not persisting through plays
[*]fixed a bug in repair wave and certain other skills that would cause the fx to stick
